items.title: Fox’s $22 Billion Roku Acquisition Nears US Antitrust Clearance, Semafor Reports
items.summary: Fox Corporation (NASDAQ:FOX) is reportedly approaching US antitrust approval for its proposed $22 billion acquisition of streaming platform Roku, with the Department of Justice considering allowing the transaction to proceed under a consent decree, according to a report published Tuesday by Semafor.
